study_design: Hospital-based case-control study using histologically confirmed prostate cancer cases and benign prostatic hyperplasia controls
cohort_total_n_excerpt: 72 histologically proven prostate 'Cancer Cases' and 132 'BPH controls' were included for the study after obtaining their Informed Consent.
reason: The study compares general prostate cancer cases with BPH controls. The abstract does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incident prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The present study aims to study association of various modifiable risk factors with Prostate Cancer and Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia.
estimate_classifications.reason: The alcohol estimate concerns general prostate cancer versus BPH controls; no aggressive disease definition is provided.
